title: SnowfallSMP Pack
description: The (optional!) client-side pack for the SnowFallSMP server! Includes client optimizers, QOL mods, and client versions of server-side mods (Status, Elytra Trims & Armor Poser).
body:
Welcome to the optional client-side modpack designed for SnowFallSMP! This is a vanilla-friendly pack with QOL enhancements, client optimizers, and client versions of our server-side mods. (Status, Elytra Trims & Armor Poser)

### This pack includes the following mods commonly disallowed on public servers:
- Freecam
- Auto Clicker
- Xaero's MiniMap + WorldMap
- Gamma Utils (Full Bright)

## Also Inclulded:
- Auto Reconnect & Auto ReAuth
- Better Stats Screen
- Chat Heads & Locator Heads
- Craft Presence (Rich Discord Presence)
- Crash Assistant (Often tells you why you crashed, not always)
- Flex HUD
- Jade
- JEI
- No Chat Reports
- Peek
- Replay Mod
- Scribble (text formatting in books)
- Simple Voice Chat
- Stack Refill
- Status
- Symbol Chat
- Xaero Custom Waypoint Colors
- Xaero Share

Thank you for taking the time to read this description. Have a good day!
